name: message_wording_only
reason: Error wording is unspecified by the validation contract.

name: text_empty_allowed
reason: Empty text is outside the accepted text contract.

name: text_limit_off_by_one
reason: The inclusive 120-character boundary is part of the contract.

name: integer_accepts_bool
reason: Booleans must not pass as integers.

name: timestamp_accepts_offset
reason: UTC timestamps require the Z marker; offsets are rejected.

name: unknown_status_allowed
reason: Status values are limited to the published set.

name: equivalent_comment_only
reason: A comment has no runtime effect under the validation contract.

name: equivalent_parentheses_only
reason: Parentheses around the returned integer have no runtime effect.
